rows.label: qst620202_msg0002
rows.name:
This field used to be full of
vegetables, but now it is completely
empty.

rows.label: qst620202_msg0003
rows.name:
Find whoever stole my vegetables.
You're the only ones I can rely on.

rows.label: qst620202_msg0101
rows.name:
How is the search for the culprit
going?

rows.label: qst620202_msg0102
rows.name:
I'd like to hear from those three
Blades.

rows.label: qst620202_msg0201
rows.name:
I never imagined a monster like that
was the culprit...

rows.label: qst620202_msg0203
rows.name:
A Driver and Blades were probably the
only ones who could handle it.

rows.label: qst620202_msg0204
rows.name:
I'd like to thank those three too.
Bring them over, would you?
